description: Defines an abstract base class 'NamespacedEntityIdWithType' implementing entity identifiers with namespace awareness and type handling, including methods for compatibility checks, equality, and hashing; part of the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: NamespacedEntityIdWithType
classes.description: An immutable abstract class representing entity IDs that have a namespace and type, providing methods for compatibility checks, equality, and encapsulating a delegate entity ID.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Returns the namespace part of the entity ID.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name part of the entity ID.

methods.name: isCompatibleOrThrow
methods.description: Checks whether the provided entity ID is compatible with this one, throwing an exception if not.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for equality with another object, considering ID delegate and entity type.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on delegate ID, namespace, and entity type.
